entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An ancient dragon with a master plan for dominion over the Multiverse, who recruits minions on Alara.

entities.name: Gwafa Hazid
entities.description: A human master merchant of Bant's Grand Caravan, ambitious and persuasive, recruited by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Rakka Mar
entities.description: A nearly fifty-year-old human elementalist shaman of Jund who summons elementals of rage and flame and serves Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Grand Caravan
entities.description: Bant's greatest convoy of leotau-pulled trade carts across the five nations.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A pastoral shard of kingdoms with a rigid caste hierarchy.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A savage, predatory shard where humans hold Life Hunts.

entities.name: Life Hunt
entities.description: Jund's tradition of gathering almost suicidally brave warriors to assault enormous prey.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The coming collision of the shards.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane whose fate is tied to Hazid's ambition.

events.summary: Gwafa Hazid escapes punishment for not-quite-legal goods by persuading inspectors and rulers to look elsewhere.
events.quote: whenever any not-quite-legal goods find their way onto one of his many caravans, his head never finds its way into the pillory for it

events.summary: Nicol Bolas recruits Gwafa Hazid as a minion for his master plan.
events.quote: which is exactly why Nicol Bolas reached out to him to serve as part of the dragon's master plan

events.summary: Rakka Mar drifts from clan to clan offering elemental summoning, enduring many Life Hunts.
events.quote: Rakka Mar has drifted from clan to clan of human warriors

events.summary: Nicol Bolas recruits Rakka Mar as a minion.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas saw the potential in Rakka Mar immediately.

events.summary: Bolas uses Rakka's influence to promote greater Life Hunts, preparing the war-clans for war with other shards once the Conflux begins.
events.quote: Bolas has used Rakka's influence among the human war-clans to promote even greater and more dramatic Life Hunts

events.summary: Rakka Mar gains dark powers of elementalism in return.
events.quote: In return, Rakka has gained dark powers of elementalism

relations.note: Hazid is recruited as a minion.
relations.quote: Nicol Bolas reached out to him to serve as part of the dragon's master plan

relations.note: Rakka knows her status as a minion and is willing to play her part.
relations.quote: She knows her status as a minion

relations.note: Hazid is a master merchant of the Caravan.
relations.quote: Gwafa Hazid is a master merchant of Bant's Grand Caravan
